title: fix: extract haversine function to shared module

issue.title: TASK-a89b fix: extract haversine function to shared module

description:
## Goal
Fix the Next.js build error caused by exporting a non-route helper function (hav) from an API route file. Next.js auto-generated types reject any exports beyond standard HTTP methods and route config.

## Requirements
- Extract the haversine distance function (hav) from app/api/route/route.ts into a shared module (lib/geo.ts)
- Import hav in the route handler and tests from the new shared module
- Remove the export of hav from the route file
- Build and tests must pass after the change

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] lib/geo.ts contains the hav function with proper type definitions
- [ ] app/api/route/route.ts imports hav from lib/geo.ts instead of defining it locally
- [ ] tests/route.test.ts imports hav from lib/geo.ts instead of from the route file
- [ ] hav is not exported from app/api/route/route.ts
- [ ] npm run build passes without TypeScript errors
- [ ] npm run test:run passes

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Build compiles successfully
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] No non-route exports from API route files
- [ ] Code follows existing project conventions
